title: Oven Roasted Filipino Chicken Breast Tinola
description: A flexitarian-friendly Filipino dish featuring chicken breast cooked in an en-croute style with a floral and glassy-jelly texture, perfect for meal prep. This recipe is a unique twist on the traditional tinola dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together patis, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced ginger, chopped onion, minced garlic, and sliced chili peppers to the bowl and mix well.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and coat with the marinade.
Wrap the chicken breast in parchment paper and place on a baking sheet.
Roast the chicken in the oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and add the chopped spinach and bruised lemongrass on top.
Return the chicken to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve the chicken breast with the roasted spinach and lemongrass sauce.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
